# We're building the perception platform for automation.
:::

::: {.ethos-section}

::: {.ethos-content}
At MIT in Cambridge we studied how humans perceive the world, then pioneered GPU-powered algorithms that rivaled state-of-the-art vision models. Next, we discovering nueral computation. Meanwhile at Stripe in San Francisco, engineers honed a renewed focus on user experience, AI infrastructure, and globally scalable developer platforms. Today, Perceptual is a linear combination of these worlds, unlocking automation at scale.
:::
